scope: Fixed before minibatch training. Six fresh author source-only cases (four factual formations,two acknowledgments), plus four new transitions on previously exposed actual35B-model banks. The latter are not new independent histories. Author development evaluation, not formal holdout or external confirmation. Review dimensions never enter model messages.
